name: get_session
description: Inspect the shared session and its generation.

process_id.description: Stable debugger process ID; omitted means original process 1, independent of GUI selection.

name: list_threads
description: List threads and their stable session-local IDs.

process_id.description: Stable debugger process ID; omitted means original process 1, independent of GUI selection.

name: get_registers
description: Read target general registers from a stopped thread; values are hexadecimal strings. On LoongArch64, r0 is the kernel restart slot, not architectural zero.

process_id.description: Stable debugger process ID; omitted means original process 1, independent of GUI selection.

name: read_memory
description: Read up to 4096 bytes from the stopped process, returning hex bytes and the actual count.

address.description: Hexadecimal string (with optional 0x), or a nonnegative JSON integer at most 9007199254740991. Use a hex string for larger addresses to preserve every bit.

process_id.description: Stable debugger process ID; omitted means original process 1, independent of GUI selection.

name: disassemble
description: Decode up to 32 native target instructions at a stopped process address.

process_id.description: Stable debugger process ID; omitted means original process 1, independent of GUI selection.

name: query_events
description: Read up to 128 ordered events after a sequence number. Older events may have expired from the bounded history.

process_id.description: Stable debugger process ID; omitted means original process 1, independent of GUI selection.

name: get_breakpoints
description: Inspect installed software breakpoints and hardware watchpoints.

process_id.description: Stable debugger process ID; omitted means original process 1, independent of GUI selection.

name: get_audit
description: Inspect recent human and agent control actions.

process_id.description: Stable debugger process ID; omitted means original process 1, independent of GUI selection.

name: set_breakpoint
description: Set software breakpoints by address, ELF symbol, or source file and line. Returns all probe IDs for a source line. Symbol requests remain pending until resolved, including glibc shared library loads.

process_id.description: Stable debugger process ID; omitted means original process 1, independent of GUI selection.

name: remove_breakpoint
description: Remove a software breakpoint; requires control scope.

process_id.description: Stable debugger process ID; omitted means original process 1, independent of GUI selection.

name: set_watchpoint
description: Set a hardware watchpoint on all threads; requires control scope.

process_id.description: Stable debugger process ID; omitted means original process 1, independent of GUI selection.

name: remove_watchpoint
description: Remove a hardware watchpoint; requires control scope.

process_id.description: Stable debugger process ID; omitted means original process 1, independent of GUI selection.

name: continue
description: Continue the target; returns before the next stop. Requires control scope.

process_id.description: Stable debugger process ID; omitted means original process 1, independent of GUI selection.

name: interrupt
description: Request a stop; poll get_session until stopped. Requires control scope.

process_id.description: Stable debugger process ID; omitted means original process 1, independent of GUI selection.

name: step_instruction
description: Step one machine instruction in one stopped thread. Requires control scope.

process_id.description: Stable debugger process ID; omitted means original process 1, independent of GUI selection.

name: write_memory
description: Write target bytes supplied as hexadecimal. Requires mutate scope.

process_id.description: Stable debugger process ID; omitted means original process 1, independent of GUI selection.

name: write_register
description: Write one native target general register. Requires mutate scope.

process_id.description: Stable debugger process ID; omitted means original process 1, independent of GUI selection.

name: find_symbol
description: Resolve an ELF symbol to a live runtime address.

process_id.description: Stable debugger process ID; omitted means original process 1, independent of GUI selection.

name: list_modules
description: List one page of the retained process memory mappings and module load failures. Follow next with cursor until null. Cursors are bound to the process session, mapping generation and contents; StaleModuleCursor requires restarting at the first page. Running targets expose the last stopped mapping snapshot.

process_id.description: Stable debugger process ID; omitted means original process 1, independent of GUI selection.

cursor.description: Opaque next value from the preceding page; omit to begin.

limit.description: Maximum combined region/failure rows; the response byte budget may return fewer.

name: evaluate_expression
description: Evaluate a side-effect-free C/C++ scalar, pointer, struct-field, or $register expression in a stopped frame.

inline_depth.description: Inline scope within the physical frame, 0 innermost; inline_frames length selects the outer physical function.

process_id.description: Stable debugger process ID; omitted means original process 1, independent of GUI selection.

name: step_over_instruction
description: Step one instruction, running calls to their return address. Requires control scope; other threads can run while a call executes.

process_id.description: Stable debugger process ID; omitted means original process 1, independent of GUI selection.

name: get_source_location
description: Map a runtime address to its source line.

process_id.description: Stable debugger process ID; omitted means original process 1, independent of GUI selection.

name: get_stack
description: Unwind up to 64 frames using CFI. Each frame carries availability diagnostics. symbol retains the exact linkage name; symbol_display is a compact C++ name when supported (parameter and template-argument types omitted), otherwise the original name.

process_id.description: Stable debugger process ID; omitted means original process 1, independent of GUI selection.

name: list_locals
description: List visible variables and parameters, typed values and availability at a stopped frame. Paged with start/limit; next is the following start. Pass view_id from the first reply on later pages; stale views require restarting. A byte budget may shorten pages.

inline_depth.description: Inline scope within the physical frame, 0 innermost; inline_frames length selects the outer physical function.

process_id.description: Stable debugger process ID; omitted means original process 1, independent of GUI selection.

name: step_source
description: Step to a different source line, entering calls. Asynchronous, requires control scope.

process_id.description: Stable debugger process ID; omitted means original process 1, independent of GUI selection.

name: step_over
description: Step to a different source line, running calls to their return address. Asynchronous, requires control scope.

process_id.description: Stable debugger process ID; omitted means original process 1, independent of GUI selection.

name: investigate_write
description: Record an investigation and install a hardware write watchpoint on an addressable scalar expression.

process_id.description: Stable debugger process ID; omitted means original process 1, independent of GUI selection.

name: get_investigation
description: Export recorded observations, frames, values and instruction attribution with provenance.

process_id.description: Stable debugger process ID; omitted means original process 1, independent of GUI selection.

name: get_function_graph
description: Build a bounded static x86-64 function graph from stopped target bytes. Returns up to 16 blocks per page and their outgoing edges. This is decoded possibility, not observed execution; unresolved branches and assumed call returns are explicit.

process_id.description: Stable debugger process ID; omitted means original process 1, independent of GUI selection.

name: start_profile
description: Start bounded CPU sampling while stopped. All-thread captures follow new same-process threads by default; explicit tids remain fixed. Child processes remain outside scope. Preferences supply omitted options.

sample_limit.description: Maximum retained samples; default from preferences (16384 initially). Memory can fill earlier.

duration_ms.description: Wall-clock deadline in milliseconds; 0 means until stopped. Omitted settings use session defaults (initially 60000 ms, 99 Hz, scheduling off); resource and scope limits still stop collection.

context_switch.description: Per-thread scheduling transitions with bounded retention; omitted uses the session default, initially false.

user_stack_bytes.description: 0 disables (initial default); otherwise 64..8192 captured user stack bytes per sample plus x86-64 GPRs. Recommend 4096 when enabling.

user_stack_budget_bytes.description: Total retained stack-byte budget; initial default 33554432 (32 MiB). CPU samples and registers continue after exhaustion, with explicit missing stacks. Collection overhead continues.

follow_threads.description: Follow held newborn threads only when tids is omitted; default comes from preferences (true).

ring_budget_bytes.description: Total live perf data-ring budget; metadata pages are additional. Default 64 MiB.

syscall_timing.description: Opt-in x86-64 syscall timing; requires explicit tids (1..32). Arguments discarded.

syscall_limit.description: Retained syscall detail ceiling; reaching it stops capture.

process_id.description: Stable debugger process ID; omitted means original process 1, independent of GUI selection.

name: stop_profile
description: Stop collection and drain queued samples; does not pause target execution.

process_id.description: Stable debugger process ID; omitted means original process 1, independent of GUI selection.

name: release_profile
description: Release a stopped live capture and its retained image budget. Export it first to preserve it. Retry ProfileViewPending after a cancelled reader finishes.

process_id.description: Stable debugger process ID; omitted means original process 1, independent of GUI selection.

name: get_profile
description: Inspect capture status, user/kernel CPU accounting, accepted perf parameters, thread identities, loss/mapping diagnostics, and actionable start failures. Includes current session defaults for future GUI captures and omitted start_profile arguments.

process_id.description: Stable debugger process ID; omitted means original process 1, independent of GUI selection.

name: get_flamegraph
description: Get a recorded CPU flame snapshot. Omit revision on an initial live request to snapshot current data. Live requests may return pending; poll the same revision/view_id. Pass view_id for pages and frame queries. Evicted views are stale. Optional basis=reconstructed uses saved stacks on a completed capture: pending/progress first, then its own view_id, coverage buckets and per-node example_sample. Recorded remains the default; node IDs belong only to their basis and view.

retry.description: Explicitly retry a failed live snapshot build.

view_id.description: View identity from get_flamegraph; required for frame lookup and paginated continuation.

tids.description: Selected TIDs; mutually exclusive with tid. Empty selects all threads.

process_id.description: Stable debugger process ID; omitted means original process 1, independent of GUI selection.

name: get_profile_frame
description: Source and assembly for a flame node using the retained ELF image; repeat the graph filters. Representative location, not a per-line count. Works after target exit. Recorded basis only; reconstructed views use example_sample with get_profile_stack.

view_id.description: View identity from get_flamegraph; required for frame lookup and paginated continuation.

tids.description: Selected TIDs; mutually exclusive with tid. Empty selects all threads.

process_id.description: Stable debugger process ID; omitted means original process 1, independent of GUI selection.

name: get_profile_mappings
description: Read observed mapping identities and timestamps in capture-local ID order, with coverage limitations. Supply capture_id and revision; start/limit page opening ranges and retained changes.

process_id.description: Stable debugger process ID; omitted means original process 1, independent of GUI selection.

name: get_profile_timeline
description: CPU sample bins and per-thread counts with the same half-open relative-time filters as flames. Bins partition the clipped range; start/limit page threads. Includes unfiltered debugger observation markers. Scheduling status and limits are reported; use get_profile_schedule for per-thread spans. Pin capture_id/revision; stop collection for stable queries.

tids.description: Selected TIDs; mutually exclusive with tid. Empty selects all threads.

process_id.description: Stable debugger process ID; omitted means original process 1, independent of GUI selection.

name: get_profile_schedule
description: Read one opening thread’s running/off-CPU/unknown intervals, paged at 128 spans. Uses half-open relative-time filters; totals cover the whole filtered range. Missing scheduling evidence remains unknown. Pin capture_id and revision; stop for stable pagination. No wait-cause inference.

process_id.description: Stable debugger process ID; omitted means original process 1, independent of GUI selection.

name: get_instruction_effects
description: Inspect normalized typed operands and explicit/implicit register effects from stopped x86-64 bytes. Bounded inspection IR, not complete executable semantics. Memory expressions are not dereferenced; aliases/flags/implicit memory effects remain architecture-specific.

process_id.description: Stable debugger process ID; omitted means original process 1, independent of GUI selection.

name: add_profile_intervals
description: Add application-supplied timing intervals to a completed capture. Requires control scope and current target generation plus capture/revision. Atomic batch, at most 128 records and 4096 retained. Times are relative nanoseconds within capture extent; imported provenance is explicit. No target execution change.

process_id.description: Stable debugger process ID; omitted means original process 1, independent of GUI selection.

name: get_profile_intervals
description: Read imported application intervals overlapping the same half-open relative range/TID used by flames. Endpoints and caller-supplied provenance are retained; these are not kernel observations. Global intervals match any selected TID.

tids.description: Selected TIDs; mutually exclusive with tid. Empty selects all threads.

process_id.description: Stable debugger process ID; omitted means original process 1, independent of GUI selection.

name: export_profile
description: Write a completed selected CPU aggregate as a new Speedscope JSON file, with xodb metadata, CPU bins, scheduling totals and imported intervals. Units are sample counts and ordering is synthetic. No overwrite. Requires control scope and current generation plus capture/revision; target execution is unchanged.

tids.description: Selected TIDs; mutually exclusive with tid. Empty selects all threads.

process_id.description: Stable debugger process ID; omitted means original process 1, independent of GUI selection.

name: get_value_children
description: Read paged struct/array/Rust-Zig slice children from stopped memory; no target calls or automatic pointer traversal. raw=true exposes slice fields. Observe scope.

inline_depth.description: Inline scope within the physical frame, 0 innermost; inline_frames length selects the outer physical function.

process_id.description: Stable debugger process ID; omitted means original process 1, independent of GUI selection.

name: save_capture_archive
description: Start a background save of a completed capture or copy an immutable offline artifact to a new file. Poll get_archive_status for publication.

process_id.description: Stable debugger process ID; omitted means original process 1, independent of GUI selection.

name: get_archive_status
description: Read archive job progress, publication result, recorded origin and analysis identity.

process_id.description: Stable debugger process ID; omitted means original process 1, independent of GUI selection.

name: cancel_archive_job
description: Request cooperative cancellation. Publication may already have completed; inspect get_archive_status.

process_id.description: Stable debugger process ID; omitted means original process 1, independent of GUI selection.

name: get_profile_samples
description: Read normalized recorded samples with durable zero-based ordinals. Addresses are original evidence; no target memory is read.

process_id.description: Stable debugger process ID; omitted means original process 1, independent of GUI selection.

name: get_profile_stack
description: Inspect saved registers and paged stack bytes. By default queue completed-capture DWARF reconstruction on a worker; repeat the same request while pending. reconstruct=false reads raw evidence during collection. No target reads/resume. Existing archive status/cancel tools manage the worker.

process_id.description: Stable debugger process ID; omitted means original process 1, independent of GUI selection.

name: get_profile_stack_coverage
description: Counts of retained and missing sampled stacks by thread within a half-open relative time range. Retention follows drain order; no guaranteed time prefix. Unfilterable records are counted separately.

tids.description: Selected TIDs; mutually exclusive with tid. Empty selects all threads.

process_id.description: Stable debugger process ID; omitted means original process 1, independent of GUI selection.

name: get_debug_view
description: Bounded coherent GUI snapshot; explicit server --source shares one source file. Schema version 1.

summary_only.description: Return only identity, generation, state and scope without inspection or thread rows.

process_id.description: Stable debugger process ID; omitted means original process 1, independent of GUI selection.

name: detach
description: Detach and preserve the target; requires control scope and the viewed generation.

process_id.description: Stable debugger process ID; omitted means original process 1, independent of GUI selection.

name: configure_breakpoint
description: Replace a breakpoint policy. Conditions and log expressions are side-effect-free; errors stop. Ignore counts consume matching-thread hits before conditions. Empty condition clears it. Thread filters bind to stable identity. Requires stopped target and control scope.

process_id.description: Stable debugger process ID; omitted means original process 1, independent of GUI selection.

name: get_breakpoint_logs
description: Read bounded logpoint observations by sequence; overwritten observations are explicitly counted. Value evidence belongs to the recorded image/generation.

process_id.description: Stable debugger process ID; omitted means original process 1, independent of GUI selection.

name: finish
description: Run until the selected physical frame returns. Thread and caller stack identity distinguish recursive calls. Other meaningful stops interrupt the operation.

process_id.description: Stable debugger process ID; omitted means original process 1, independent of GUI selection.

name: run_to
description: Run to an address or source line on the selected thread. Other meaningful stops interrupt the operation; temporary probe ownership is preserved.

process_id.description: Stable debugger process ID; omitted means original process 1, independent of GUI selection.

name: capture_memory
description: Capture stopped memory with per-byte availability: address+length (at most 16 MiB), or ranges (1-16 ranges, each at most 16 MiB, 32 MiB total) captured in one stop. Observations are immutable and pageable with read_memory_snapshot after resuming. At most 64 observations and 64 MiB are retained; the oldest replaceable ones expire first.

process_id.description: Stable debugger process ID; omitted means original process 1, independent of GUI selection.

name: read_memory_snapshot
description: Page an immutable observation and optionally compare an overlapping baseline from the same session/image. ?? marks unreadable bytes.

process_id.description: Stable debugger process ID; omitted means original process 1, independent of GUI selection.

name: search_memory
description: Start one bounded incremental search of stopped memory with one hit list (max 4096 hits). Give address+length (max 1 GiB), ranges (up to 1024 ascending non-overlapping ranges), or regions: writable = rw private mappings incl. file-backed .data/.bss, anon-writable = rw private without a file path, all-readable = every readable private mapping; shared mappings only with include_shared; address+length then clips regions to a window. Multi-range total max 4 GiB; hits never span two ranges. Local bulk reads scan several GB/s, a remote agent hundreds of MB/s. Poll get_memory_search. Target resume/change makes it stale.

process_id.description: Stable debugger process ID; omitted means original process 1, independent of GUI selection.

name: get_memory_search
description: Page matches and inspect progress, unreadable coverage and terminal reason; range_start/range_limit page per-range coverage and hit counts.

process_id.description: Stable debugger process ID; omitted means original process 1, independent of GUI selection.

name: cancel_memory_search
description: Cancel only the named memory search; target execution is unchanged.

process_id.description: Stable debugger process ID; omitted means original process 1, independent of GUI selection.

name: get_extended_registers
description: Read x86-64 x87/SSE and available AVX/AVX-512 state, with typed low-to-high vector lanes. Read-only; unsupported widths are explicit.

process_id.description: Stable debugger process ID; omitted means original process 1, independent of GUI selection.

name: restart
description: Restart the original owned launch while stopped or exited. Preserve symbolic and build-ID-verified breakpoint locations. Clear address watches; thread-filtered breakpoints require rebinding. Attached targets cannot restart.

process_id.description: Stable debugger process ID; omitted means original process 1, independent of GUI selection.

name: get_debug_files
description: List retained verified debug companions and explicit source prefix substitutions. No file contents are returned. Paged with start/limit; next is the following start. Pass view_id from the first reply on later pages; stale views require restarting. A byte budget may shorten pages.

process_id.description: Stable debugger process ID; omitted means original process 1, independent of GUI selection.

name: get_core_info
description: Describe a read-only ELF core, its recorded process/thread IDs, mappings and missing-memory semantics.

process_id.description: Stable debugger process ID; omitted means original process 1, independent of GUI selection.

name: get_stop_info
description: Inspect a stopped thread signal, kernel code, fault address and whether Continue would deliver a pending signal.

process_id.description: Stable debugger process ID; omitted means original process 1, independent of GUI selection.

name: get_profile_syscalls
description: Page scoped x86-64 syscall entry/exit elapsed durations, raw return values and observed scheduling overlap. Missing endpoints stay null; durations include debugger pauses. Arguments are not retained.

tids.description: Selected TIDs; mutually exclusive with tid. Empty selects all threads.

process_id.description: Stable debugger process ID; omitted means original process 1, independent of GUI selection.

name: get_processes
description: List retained process sessions and held child admissions. MCP defaults to process 1; GUI selection never retargets requests.

process_id.description: Stable debugger process ID; omitted means original process 1, independent of GUI selection.

name: set_process_following
description: Enable or disable future process following for a stopped x86-64 process. Children stop for inspection; inherited following remains enabled. Optional process_limit bounds retained sessions globally.

process_id.description: Stable debugger process ID; omitted means original process 1, independent of GUI selection.

name: retry_process_admission
description: Retry children held by process limit or adoption errors after correcting the cause.

process_id.description: Stable debugger process ID; omitted means original process 1, independent of GUI selection.

name: detach_process_family
description: Detach this process and any shared-vfork family, including pending children. Restores all traps before resuming any member. Independent adopted fork processes remain attached.

process_id.description: Stable debugger process ID; omitted means original process 1, independent of GUI selection.

name: start_allocations
description: Prepare bounded x86-64 allocation tracing on stopped, explicitly selected threads. Poll get_allocation_capture before continuing. May invoke an explicitly configured privileged helper.

mapping_address.description: Address within the executable mapping; default is unique libc.so.6.

callstacks.description: Collect bounded frame-pointer prefixes and the return address at allocator entry. Default true.

name: stop_allocations
description: Stop and drain a capture or cancel preparation. Requires its session/capture identity and current target generation.

name: get_allocation_capture
description: Inspect preparation, failures, retained allocation coverage and lifetime summary. Outstanding does not mean leaked.

name: get_allocation_events
description: Page exact retained entry/return events and evidence gaps.

name: get_allocation_calls
description: Page paired calls with event citations; incomplete calls retain reasons.

name: get_allocation_lifetimes
description: Build/page bounded allocation lifetimes. Outstanding is within recorded scope, not proof of a leak.

name: get_allocation_stack
description: Read the captured entry stack for an allocation call; prefixes never imply a complete unwind.

name: get_allocation_flamegraph
description: Build/page allocation call trees weighted by requested bytes or successful allocation count. Poll pending with the same filters.

name: save_allocation_archive
description: Save finalized allocation evidence and recorded stack labels without overwriting a file. Poll get_archive_status for completion.

process_id.description: Stable debugger process ID; omitted means original process 1, independent of GUI selection.

name: get_profile_comparison
description: Inspect an explicitly opened pair of CPU archives. Poll pending, then page normalized function rankings or differential flames; no elapsed-time or speedup inference.

name: start_inspection
description: Retain a bounded coherent inspection of one stopped thread. Poll get_inspection; results survive resume. Eight retained jobs maximum; release explicitly.

name: get_inspection
description: Read immutable completed items and progress from a retained inspection. Each item has an ordinal and independent availability.

name: cancel_inspection
description: Cancel pending inspection work; retain already captured items.

name: release_inspection
description: Release a retained inspection and its memory; cancels pending work.

name: start_observation
description: Prepare generic function entry/return probes for selected held threads in one exact ELF mapping. Poll get_observation until collecting before continue; x86-64 SysV raw words only.

name: stop_observation
description: Disable and drain this observation, preserving incomplete and lost evidence.

name: get_observation
description: Observation preparation/collection status, exact source and thread identities, limits and loss.

name: get_observation_calls
description: Page immutable calls after collection ends. Raw register and address words use hex strings.

name: get_observation_records
description: Page immutable records after collection ends. Raw register and address words use hex strings.

name: compare_observation
description: Start bounded asynchronous fast/slow wall-duration cohorts from complete calls. Cite raw entry/return records and exclude incomplete evidence.

name: get_observation_comparison
description: Get observation comparison job; identity and exact cohort denominators are retained.

name: cancel_observation_comparison
description: Cancel observation comparison job; identity and exact cohort denominators are retained.

name: save_observation
description: Save ended invocation evidence as a self-contained .xoi investigation; destination must be new. Poll get_observation_archive.

name: get_observation_archive
description: Get observation save/open progress, error and actual publication status.

name: cancel_observation_archive
description: Cancel unfinished observation archive work; an already published artifact remains published.

name: associate_observation
description: Build bounded temporal associations from ended native CPU/syscall/allocation captures to complete function calls. Explicit source identities/revisions required; overlap is not causal cost.

name: get_observation_associations
description: Read classified associations, exact denominators, captured clock proof and raw-record citations. Optional stream_id pages owned normalized input records.

name: cancel_observation_associations
description: Cancel a pending temporal association job.

name: get_language_stack
description: Read bounded language stack evidence at a retained native stop. Lua, JavaScript, Python, Perl, Ruby, Go (goroutines) and GDScript (Godot 4/Redot call stack joined to native frames); no target calls.

state.description: Lua only: explicit lua_State address as hexadecimal. Omit to recover native state arguments.

name: import_logical_frames
description: Import declared logical JSONL or a JVM export asynchronously; exact weights are counts.

name: open_frame_bundle
description: Restore retained frame evidence without opening recorded source paths.

name: get_frame_status
description: Import status, source identities, collection method, read stability, loss and budget.

name: get_frame_threads
description: Logical thread evidence; runtime IDs do not grant native control.

name: get_frame_stacks
description: Logical stack records, original weights, acquisition and source citations.

name: get_frame_stack
description: Page through logical frames; native stacks remain separate.

name: get_frame_functions
description: Function identity, source locations, JVM loader and execution-mode evidence.

name: get_frame_aggregate
description: Completed exact decimal aggregate counts with partial and unknown-leaf weights.

name: select_frame_aggregate
description: Run one bounded aggregate for a selected logical thread; null means all.

name: get_frame_citation
description: Return up to 4096 original source or adapted logical bytes as hex.

name: save_frames
description: Publish a no-overwrite .xof frame evidence bundle asynchronously.

name: cancel_frame_job
description: Request cancellation of the current frame import, aggregate or save.

name: import_jit_map
description: Import a declared jitdump/perf-map source with explicit process and clock facts. Metadata is operator-declared.

name: prepare_jit_profile
description: Prepare JIT labels for up to 64 native samples on a bounded worker; stops collection first.

name: get_jit_profile
description: Read prepared native PC labels, resolver outcomes, candidates and lifetime citations.

name: get_jit_stack
description: Page prepared native-profile caller labels, preserving raw PCs and uncertainty.

name: get_jit_candidates
description: Page candidates for a prepared sampled leaf or caller frame; names have bounded previews and original byte citations.

name: get_debug_metadata
description: Inspect background debug-data progress and availability without target I/O.

name: cancel_debug_metadata
description: Cancel a debug-data job and withdraw its result.

name: retry_debug_metadata
description: Discard a metadata result so the next stack or value request retries.

name: get_language_tabs
description: Read right-pane selection and runtime version, build ID, proof generation and reader diagnostics.

name: select_language_tab
description: Select a detected right-pane tab; presentation only, does not resume or mutate the target.

name: select_native_frame
description: Select a native frame and offer language segments with reader-proved matching anchors. No target mutation.

name: select_language_frame
description: Select a logical row and highlight its reader-proved native segment anchor. Unproved anchors stay partial; no target mutation.

name: get_language_locals
description: Page retained language bindings. Emacs returns per-frame dynamic bindings and saved interpreter environments; optimized compiled locals remain unproved. JavaScript returns context storage with lexical visibility explicitly unproved, scope depth and provenance; stack-only bindings are not shown. GDScript (Godot 4 / Redot) returns the parameters and locals of the call level, then self and the script instance's members, each with a Variant preview and its first children; local names need the engine to have recorded them (GDScriptLocalNamesNotTracked otherwise: parameters keep their names, other slots are listed as stack[N]). Unavailable layouts and names have diagnostics; no target code runs.

name: evaluate_language_expression
description: Resolve a bounded language expression in a retained logical frame without target execution. Lua accepts an ASCII local/upvalue name plus up to four .identifier or [int32] raw-table selectors (128 bytes); metatables are refused; Lua 5.4 follows at most 128 collision nodes while Lua 5.2 hash scans remain capped at 128 slots; Perl accepts a sigil plus ASCII identifier from the active pad. Python accepts exact fast-local, cell and free-variable roots with up to four [int32] or quoted printable ASCII-key subscripts (128 bytes), through exact builtin dict/list/tuple storage; custom keys, subclasses and oversized scans refuse. JavaScript refuses unproved bare names with JavaScriptLexicalUnproved: a retained context name may be shadowed by a stack binding. GDScript accepts a local, parameter or member name, or self, plus up to eight .member, [integer] or ["text"] steps (128 bytes) through Array, Dictionary, packed arrays, script members of objects and vector components; a missing name, key or index is a diagnostic with no rows. These readers refuse target execution.

name: get_language_watches
description: Read cached stopped-language watch values and previous values; never performs target reads.

name: add_language_watch
description: Create a bounded stopped-language comparison watch. Lua/Python accept bounded container paths or a row; Perl/Ruby accept a name or row; JavaScript accepts only an explicit context-storage row, with lexical visibility and continuous activation lifetime unproved. Re-resolves storage; never runs target code.

name: remove_language_watch
description: Remove a stopped-language comparison watch.
